paragraphs: Rabbi Avdumi bar Tuvi: [Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Moed_Katan.3.5.16).
Rabbi Avimi bar Tuvi: [Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra, chapter 2, halakhah 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Batra.2.3.6).

notes.text: The four notices are independent. Moed Katan spells the first name אבודמי and gives him as a transmitter of Rabbi Abbahu; compare [Heilprin’s Avdumi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=96&lang=en). The Natan passage is at [Berakhot 28a:16](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.28a.16), beside Hyman’s 25a. [Heilprin’s Natan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2737&lang=en) also points to 28a.
